title: Curtis’s conjecture

result.label: Curtis’s conjecture
result.statement: Proves Curtis’s conjecture: the positive-degree mod-two stable Hurewicz image of the sphere is spanned by the images of the Hopf-invariant-one classes η , ν , σ and the Kervaire-invariant-one classes that exist.
